column1: # Bicep: every named top-level declaration, at the line of the keyword (a decorator
# on the lines above belongs to it).
#   param, output -> variable      var -> constant      type -> type_alias
#   func -> function               resource, module (including existing and loops) -> class
# Not definitions: properties inside a resource or module object, loop variables,
# metadata, targetScope, uses of a symbol (storage.id), decorators, and the
# `param x = value` lines of a .bicepparam file (they assign, they do not declare).
